title: Missile crisis: the hard truths about America's military arsenal
content: CBS News reported that Lockheed Martin has signed a contract worth roughly $59 billion to build additional Patriot interceptors, on top of a separate, smaller contract for lower-cost missiles, as the Pentagon works to replenish stockpiles depleted during the war with Iran. A defense analyst interviewed for the segment estimated it could take one to five years to rebuild stockpiles to pre-war levels, depending on the specific munition.
